chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn Sallar Abu 'Amrah, from Abu Maryam al-Thaqafi, from 'Ammar ibn Yasir, who said:

While I was in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The special, pure Shi'ah from us, the People of the Household.' So 'Umar said, 'O Messenger of Allah, introduce them to us so that we may recognize them.' The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'I did not say to you except that I wish to inform you.' Then the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'I am the guide to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, and 'Ali is the support of the Religion and its beacon. The People of the Household are the lamps by whom light is sought.' So 'Umar said, 'O Messenger of Allah, and what about the one whose heart is not compatible with this?' The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The heart was not placed in that position except to be compatible or opposed. So whoever's heart is compatible with us, the People of the Household, will be saved, and whoever's heart is opposed to us, the People of the Household, will be destroyed.'
ai.seo_question: Who are the special Shi'ah according to the Prophet in this hadith?
ai.summary: In this foundational hadith from al-Kafi, the Prophet clarifies that the 'special Shi'ah' are defined not merely by name but by the alignment of their hearts with the Ahl al-Bayt, whom he metaphorically designates as the 'lamps' (Mashābīḥ) guiding the community. This narration underscores the Shia doctrine of Walāyah, establishing that spiritual salvation (najāt) and destruction (halk) are directly contingent upon one's internal concordance with the Prophet and his progeny, a concept deeply rooted in the verse of purification and the verse of kinship.

en.hubeali: H 14966 – Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Sallar Abu Umrat, from Abu Maryam Al-Saqafy, from Ammar Bin Yasser who said:

Whilst I was in the presence of the Rasool Allahsaww, when the Rasool Allahsaww said that: ‘The Shites,the special ones, the sincere ones are from usasws the Peopleasws of the Household’. So Umar said, ‘O Rasool Allahsaww, introduce them until we recognise them’. So the Rasool Allahsaww said: ‘Isaww am not saying to you except that Isaww want to inform you’. Then the Rasool Allahsaww said: ‘Isaww am the Guide to Allahazwj and Aliasws is the support of the Religion, and its beacons are the Peopleasws of the Household, and theyasws are the Lights of the Religion by whomasws it is illuminated’. So Umar said, ‘O Rasool Allahsaww, so the one whose heart is not compatible with this?’ So the Rasool Allahsaww said: ‘The heart has not been placed in that place except that it is either compatible with it or it is opposed to it. So the one whose heart is compatible with usasws the Peopleasws of the Household, would be the saved one, and the one whose heart was opposed to usasws the Peopleasws of the Household, would be destroyed’.
en.sarwar: 519. Ahmad, from Ali Bin Al-Hakam, from Quteyba Al-A’ashy who said:

I heard Abu Abdullah (a.s.) saying: ‘You have antagonised your fathers, and your sons, and your wives with regards to us (a.s.), and your Reward is upon Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic. But rather, it would be most needed when you are in a state when your souls reach to here’ – and he (a.s.) gestured by his (a.s.) hand to his (a.s.) throat’.
